cases.name: add-style-creates-default-part
cases.deviation: upstream's save regenerates [Content_Types].xml from the parts it holds, dropping the unrelated stale Override for the missing /word/stylesWithEffects.xml; Rust replaces only the stale /word/styles.xml Override and leaves the rest untouched (narrow save; every member's effective content type is identical)

cases.deviation: upstream's save regenerates [Content_Types].xml from the parts it holds, dropping the unrelated stale Override for the missing /word/stylesWithEffects.xml; Rust replaces only the stale /word/styles.xml Override and leaves the rest untouched (narrow save; every member's effective content type is identical)

cases.name: read-creates-default-part-upstream
cases.deviation: upstream `document.styles` adds the default styles part as a side effect of reading; Rust reads the bundled default without editing the package
